name: Nina Retail POS
author: ninadarwin998

sections.description:
Nina Retail POS helps small businesses manage:

  • Products
  • Inventory
  • POS checkout
  • Barcode workflow
  • Cashier operations
  • Low stock alerts

Designed for shops, kiosks, cafes, and small retail businesses.

The separate Pro version includes advanced analytics, cashier reports, export tools, premium receipt templates, and priority support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Nina Retail POS from the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does it support barcode products?

Yes.

Does it track inventory?

Yes.

Does it include low stock alerts?

Yes.

short_description: Simple POS and inventory management system for WordPress.
